scenario: [LTSL.2.3]: a test with no `inputs` asserts only over time passing and must supply `until` to advance the clock; one with neither is refused with DS_VALIDATE_TEST_NO_INPUTS_OR_UNTIL. The test has a `produces` section and nothing else. Path: `dsc.dstest.ltsl_2_3_block_shape`.
rules_ds:
schema Reading scope logical:
    zone: String key
    celsius: Float mutable

rule cold:

->
    log info "cold"

test "no clock":
    produces:
        never activated cold
